onMiss: Read the flagged items. Post one short chat line with a 0 to 100% status per tab, each with what done means and what is missing (c58). demo_ci_ok 0: fix the virev-demo test or type error first. For each no_pick app whose open steps show no live job, start one variant set job built against the canonical flows (apps/llm-wiki/content/sessions/2026/10/10/1716-canonical-flows-storyboards), using the frontend design skill, about 70% building and 30% visual checks, no mobile or accessibility passes on mocks. When a set is built and checked in a desktop browser, put one For you todo for that app with links and screenshots inline. Never write picks into lines/staging.json; the owner picks with Put in line. Fixes are one commit on the local sieun/dev tip under the VP of CI git rules. Never deploy to staging or prod, never move anything to 5174 or the real app, and never ask the owner to (c40).
